book.name: Salmo
book.title: Salmo I Libru Lingag dad Bel Israél

content: Ani satu lingag i bel Kora.

content.text: Kdeeyu dad to, samdafì gamu falel di klehewyu!
Mkit gamu dmayen Dwata,
du i Amuito Dwata Too Mdatah i gablà kanlikò;
kenen i mdatah harì mebe kdee di klamang banwe.
Tablén gito gnagan misan dad to di sahal banwe;
tafkahan ale di dungan falel i bliito.
Kenen i malék i tanà gumneito,
i too mabtas nfun Dyékob i gutambulito toon kando.
Samfulê Amuito Dwata di gumnean di tah gagin kit i dad to dmayen kenen na uni dad féw,
du tagfisanan dad dmuen kenen.
Mlingag ito dayenito Dwata, mlingag ito dayenito!
Mlingag ito dayenito i Hariito, mlingag ito dayenito!
Du Dwata, kenen i harì mebe kdee banwe di klamang tanà;
dnayenito kenen fagu di klingag dad mabtas lingag.
Dwata i magot dad banwe,
na sudeng kenen ditù di mtiu gusudeng i mdatah harì.
Balù dad mdatah to di dad sahal banwe stifun safédito dad to Dwata,
du fdatah ale Dwata i gusmalig gutambulito Abraham;
hae, du Dwata mfun kdee glal di tah tanà;
too bong kdatahan!
